purpose: Independent verification, by the dispatching session, that the 5-round AES-128 key recovery works on a key the producer never saw.
verified_by: dispatching session (Bash) - coordinator-side corroboration, NOT independent validation under 0137a051
why_this_test: The producer's own runs recovered 2b7e151628aed2a6abf7158809cf4f3c, which is the FIPS-197 standard test key. A recovery demonstrated only on a well-known constant is weak evidence: the value could reach the output by a path other than the attack. So I generated a fresh key with secrets.token_hex(16), which no prior artifact contains, and ran the producer's unmodified binary against it.

result.key_space: full unrestricted 2^128 - no hints, no restriction

certificate.method: the recovered key was used to encrypt 4 freshly generated plaintexts under pycryptodome 3.23.0 at full 10 rounds, and compared against the same plaintexts encrypted under the key I generated. Full 10-round encryption pins the master key itself, not merely a reduced-round equivalent.
certificate.independent_implementation: pycryptodome 3.23.0 - shares no code with the attack

what_this_establishes: A working, executed, certified key recovery on 5-round AES-128 over the full unrestricted key space, reproducible on an arbitrary key, in ~27 seconds on 4 cores. The definitional reference, exhaustive search over 2^128, is 2^128 five-round encryptions - astronomically larger. BT-1 as defined in RQ-AES-003 is met at r=5.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: Novelty. The integral/square attack on 5-round AES is a standard technique and this is very probably a rediscovery. Under DEC-20260731-019 ruling 3 that recollection may be used neither to promote NOR to dismiss this result, so it is recorded as unadjudicable rather than as either.
Anything about full-round AES, or about deployed AES, at any threat model.
Any comparison against published reduced-round cryptanalysis, which remains unadjudicable in this environment in both directions.
The 6-round result is NOT of this quality: it required 12 hint bytes, and the producer stated honestly that exhaustive search over the same restricted residual would take ~25 s against its 69 s.
The 7-round probe is NOT a key recovery and carries no certificate: the last round key was supplied as input.
